```{r load-data}
# ============================================================
# LOAD DATA
# ============================================================
pedon_pack_150_p <- read.csv("../outputs/pedon_pack_150_03_05_2026.csv") %>%
  mutate(peiid = as.character(peiid))

# taxonname_clean is already in pedon_pack_150_p as taxonname_clean
# (it may have come through as taxonname_clean or taxonname_clean.x depending
# on your session — this handles both)
if ("taxonname_clean.x" %in% names(pedon_pack_150_p) && 
    !"taxonname_clean" %in% names(pedon_pack_150_p)) {
  pedon_pack_150_p <- pedon_pack_150_p %>%
    rename(taxonname_clean = taxonname_clean.x)
}

pedon_pack_series <- pedon_pack_150_p

cat("Pedons with series name: ",
    sum(!is.na(pedon_pack_series$taxonname_clean)), "/", nrow(pedon_pack_series), "\n")
```

```{r helpers}
# ============================================================
# HELPERS  (same pattern as other model scripts)
# ============================================================

`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) y else x
}

# ---- bundle constructors ----
build_plain_bundle <- function(name, outcome, train_raw, prep_rec, final_fit) {
  x_cols <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = train_raw) %>%
    select(-any_of(c(outcome, "peiid"))) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double)) %>%
    select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
    names()

  list(
    name = name, outcome = outcome, model_type = "plain",
    train_raw = train_raw, prep_rec = prep_rec,
    x_cols = x_cols, final_fit = final_fit
  )
}

build_umap_hdb_bundle <- function(name, outcome, train_raw, prep_rec, final_fit,
                                   umap_model_file, hdb_fit, z_train,
                                   umap_n_components, umap_n_neighbors,
                                   umap_min_dist = 0.1, umap_metric = "euclidean",
                                   umap_seed = NA_integer_) {
  x_cols <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = train_raw) %>%
    select(-any_of(c(outcome, "peiid"))) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double)) %>%
    select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
    names()

  list(
    name = name, outcome = outcome, model_type = "umap_hdb",
    train_raw = train_raw, prep_rec = prep_rec, x_cols = x_cols,
    final_fit = final_fit, umap_model_file = umap_model_file,
    hdb_fit = hdb_fit, train_umap_features = as.matrix(z_train),
    umap_colnames = colnames(z_train),
    umap_settings = list(
      n_components = umap_n_components, n_neighbors = umap_n_neighbors,
      min_dist = umap_min_dist, metric = umap_metric, seed = umap_seed
    )
  )
}

# ---- HDBSCAN feature addition ----
add_hdbscan_features <- function(train_umap, test_umap, outcome, minPts = 10) {
  x_train <- train_umap %>% select(-all_of(outcome))
  x_test  <- test_umap  %>% select(-all_of(outcome))

  hdb_fit <- dbscan::hdbscan(as.matrix(x_train), minPts = minPts)

  # Nearest-neighbor cluster assignment for test set
  # (more stable than dbscan::predict which isn't exported in all versions)
  train_mat <- as.matrix(x_train)
  test_mat  <- as.matrix(x_test)

  test_cluster <- apply(test_mat, 1, function(z) {
    dists <- rowSums((train_mat - matrix(z, nrow = nrow(train_mat),
                                         ncol = ncol(train_mat), byrow = TRUE))^2)
    hdb_fit$cluster[which.min(dists)]
  })

  levs <- sort(unique(c(hdb_fit$cluster, test_cluster)))

  train_hdb <- train_umap %>%
    mutate(
      hdb_cluster = factor(hdb_fit$cluster, levels = levs),
      hdb_noise   = factor(if_else(hdb_fit$cluster == 0, "noise", "cluster"),
                           levels = c("cluster", "noise"))
    )

  test_hdb <- test_umap %>%
    mutate(
      hdb_cluster = factor(test_cluster, levels = levs),
      hdb_noise   = factor(if_else(test_cluster == 0, "noise", "cluster"),
                           levels = c("cluster", "noise"))
    )

  list(train = train_hdb, test = test_hdb, fit = hdb_fit)
}
# ---- column/class cleaning before model fitting ----
drop_bad_predictors <- function(train_df, test_df, outcome,
                                id_col = "peiid", drop_cols = NULL) {
  train_df <- train_df %>% select(-any_of(drop_cols))
  test_df  <- test_df  %>% select(-any_of(drop_cols))

  train_df <- train_df %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.integer))
  test_df  <- test_df  %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.integer))

  char_preds <- setdiff(
    names(train_df)[vapply(train_df, is.character, logical(1))],
    c(id_col, outcome)
  )

  if (length(char_preds) > 0) {
    train_df <- train_df %>% select(-all_of(char_preds))
    test_df  <- test_df  %>% select(-all_of(char_preds))
  }

  pred_names <- setdiff(names(train_df), c(id_col, outcome))
  one_val <- pred_names[
    vapply(train_df[pred_names],
           function(x) length(unique(x[!is.na(x)])) <= 1, logical(1))
  ]

  if (length(one_val) > 0) {
    train_df <- train_df %>% select(-all_of(one_val))
    test_df  <- test_df  %>% select(-all_of(one_val))
  }

  list(train = train_df, test = test_df)
}

# ---- helper: columns to drop (all taxonomy labels) ----
taxonomy_drop_cols <- c(
  "taxonname_clean", "taxonname_key", "taxclname",
  "taxorder", "taxsuborder", "taxgrtgroup",
  "taxsubgrp", "taxsubgrp_mod1", "taxsubgrp_mod2", "taxsubgrp_mod3",
  "taxsubgrp_mod_group", "taxgrtgroup_mod_group", "taxsuborder_mod_group",
  "taxpartsize"
)
```

```{r prep-series-data}
# ============================================================
# PREPARE SERIES DATA
# ============================================================

MIN_N_PER_SERIES <- 5   # <-- adjust if you want more/fewer classes

df_series <- pedon_pack_series %>%
  mutate(
    taxonname_clean = str_squish(as.character(taxonname_clean)),
    taxonname_clean = na_if(taxonname_clean, "")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(taxonname_clean)) %>%
  # Normalize: Title Case, strip trailing/leading whitespace
  mutate(taxonname_clean = str_to_title(taxonname_clean)) %>%
  # Remove any remaining "SND" / "Snd" placeholders from cleaning script
  filter(!str_detect(taxonname_clean, regex("\\bsnd\\b", ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
  # Apply minimum class size filter (drop rare series entirely -- do NOT lump to Other)
  add_count(taxonname_clean, name = "series_n") %>%
  filter(series_n >= MIN_N_PER_SERIES) %>%
  select(-series_n) %>%
  mutate(taxonname_clean = factor(taxonname_clean)) %>%
  droplevels()

cat("Final: ", n_distinct(df_series$peiid), "pedons across",
    nlevels(df_series$taxonname_clean), "series\n")


```

```{r split}
# ============================================================
# TRAIN / TEST SPLIT
# ============================================================

set.seed(99)

split_series <- initial_split(df_series, prop = 0.8, strata = taxonname_clean)
train_series <- training(split_series)
test_series  <- testing(split_series)

cat("Train:", nrow(train_series), "| Test:", nrow(test_series), "\n")
```

```{r model1-rf-plain}
# ============================================================
# MODEL 1: RANDOM FOREST (PLAIN)
# ============================================================
# No taxonomy leakage: all taxonomy label columns are dropped.
# Only morphology + texture + color + depth/thickness features used.

set.seed(101)

# Drop taxonomy cols BUT keep the outcome
taxonomy_drop_cols_no_outcome <- setdiff(taxonomy_drop_cols, "taxonname_clean")

clean_series_rf <- drop_bad_predictors(
  train_df  = train_series,
  test_df   = test_series,
  outcome   = "taxonname_clean",
  id_col    = "peiid",
  drop_cols = taxonomy_drop_cols_no_outcome   # <-- outcome not in drop list
)

# Confirm outcome survived
stopifnot("taxonname_clean" %in% names(clean_series_rf$train))
cat("Outcome levels:", nlevels(clean_series_rf$train$taxonname_clean), "\n")
cat("Outcome class:", class(clean_series_rf$train$taxonname_clean), "\n")

# Recipe using the data directly, not a pre-built formula object
rec_series_rf <- recipe(taxonname_clean ~ ., data = clean_series_rf$train) %>%
  update_role(peiid, new_role = "id") %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

prep_rec_series_rf <- prep(rec_series_rf, training = clean_series_rf$train)

x_train_rf <- bake(prep_rec_series_rf, new_data = clean_series_rf$train) %>%
  select(-taxonname_clean, -peiid)
p_rf <- ncol(x_train_rf)

min_class_n_rf <- clean_series_rf$train %>%
  count(taxonname_clean) %>%
  summarise(mn = min(n)) %>%
  pull(mn)

v_rf <- max(2, min(5, min_class_n_rf))

rf_spec_series <- rand_forest(
  trees = 1500,
  mtry  = tune(),
  min_n = tune()
) %>%
  set_engine("ranger", probability = TRUE, importance = "permutation") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

wf_rf_series <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(rf_spec_series) %>%
  add_recipe(rec_series_rf)

folds_rf_series <- vfold_cv(clean_series_rf$train, v = v_rf,
                             strata = taxonname_clean)

grid_rf_series <- grid_regular(
  mtry(range = c(2, min(12, p_rf))),
  min_n(range = c(2, 20)),
  levels = 4
)

cat("Tuning RF (series plain) ...\n")
tuned_rf_series <- tune_grid(
  wf_rf_series,
  resamples = folds_rf_series,
  grid      = grid_rf_series,
  metrics   = metric_set(bal_accuracy, kap, accuracy)
)

best_rf_series <- select_best(tuned_rf_series, metric = "bal_accuracy")
cat("Best RF params:\n"); print(best_rf_series)

rf_final_series <- finalize_workflow(wf_rf_series, best_rf_series) %>%
  fit(clean_series_rf$train)

pred_rf_series <- predict(rf_final_series, clean_series_rf$test, type = "prob") %>%
  bind_cols(predict(rf_final_series, clean_series_rf$test, type = "class")) %>%
  bind_cols(clean_series_rf$test %>% select(taxonname_clean))

# ---- bundle ----
taxseries_rf_bundle <- build_plain_bundle(
  name       = "taxseries_rf_plain",
  outcome    = "taxonname_clean",
  train_raw  = clean_series_rf$train,
  prep_rec   = prep_rec_series_rf,
  final_fit  = rf_final_series
)

taxseries_rf_bundle$metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)(
  pred_rf_series,
  truth    = taxonname_clean,
  estimate = .pred_class
)

taxseries_rf_bundle$f_meas <- f_meas(
  pred_rf_series,
  truth     = taxonname_clean,
  estimate  = .pred_class,
  estimator = "macro"
)

taxseries_rf_bundle$conf_mat <- conf_mat(
  pred_rf_series,
  truth    = taxonname_clean,
  estimate = .pred_class
)

saveRDS(taxseries_rf_bundle,
        "../outputs/models/taxseries_rf_plain_bundle.rds")

cat("\n--- RF SERIES PLAIN ---\n")
print(taxseries_rf_bundle$metrics)
print(taxseries_rf_bundle$f_meas)

beep("wilhelm")
```

```{r model2-xgb-umap-hdbscan}
# ============================================================
# MODEL 2: XGBoost + UMAP + HDBSCAN
# ============================================================

set.seed(201)

clean_series_xgb <- drop_bad_predictors(
  train_df  = train_series,
  test_df   = test_series,
  outcome   = "taxonname_clean",
  id_col    = "peiid",
  drop_cols = taxonomy_drop_cols_no_outcome   # <-- same as model 1
)

# Confirm outcome survived
stopifnot("taxonname_clean" %in% names(clean_series_xgb$train))
cat("Outcome levels:", nlevels(clean_series_xgb$train$taxonname_clean), "\n")

# Recipe without the step_mutate_at/step_log for now
rec_series_xgb <- recipe(taxonname_clean ~ ., data = clean_series_xgb$train) %>%
  update_role(peiid, new_role = "id") %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

prep_rec_series_xgb <- prep(rec_series_xgb, training = clean_series_xgb$train)

x_train_xgb <- bake(prep_rec_series_xgb, new_data = clean_series_xgb$train) %>%
  select(-taxonname_clean, -peiid) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double)) %>%
  select(where(is.numeric))

x_test_xgb <- bake(prep_rec_series_xgb, new_data = clean_series_xgb$test) %>%
  select(-taxonname_clean, -peiid) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double)) %>%
  select(where(is.numeric))

# Replace non-finite with 0 for UMAP safety
x_train_xgb[!is.finite(as.matrix(x_train_xgb))] <- 0
x_test_xgb[!is.finite(as.matrix(x_test_xgb))]   <- 0

# ---- UMAP ----
# n_neighbors: use ~15 for series (many classes, want tight neighborhoods)
# n_components: 20 gives more room for many-class separation
UMAP_SEED       <- 202
UMAP_N_COMP     <- 20
UMAP_N_NEIGHBORS <- 15
UMAP_MIN_DIST   <- 0.05

cat("Fitting UMAP for series XGB ...\n")
set.seed(UMAP_SEED)
umap_fit_series <- uwot::umap(
  as.matrix(x_train_xgb),
  n_components = UMAP_N_COMP,
  n_neighbors  = UMAP_N_NEIGHBORS,
  min_dist     = UMAP_MIN_DIST,
  metric       = "euclidean",
  ret_model    = TRUE
)

uwot::save_uwot(
  umap_fit_series,
  file = "../outputs/models/taxseries2_xgb_umap_hdb_umap.uwot"
)

z_train_series <- as.data.frame(umap_fit_series$embedding)
z_test_series  <- as.data.frame(
  uwot::umap_transform(as.matrix(x_test_xgb), umap_fit_series)
)
names(z_train_series) <- paste0("U", seq_len(ncol(z_train_series)))
names(z_test_series)  <- names(z_train_series)

train_umap_series <- bind_cols(z_train_series,
                               taxonname_clean = clean_series_xgb$train$taxonname_clean)
test_umap_series  <- bind_cols(z_test_series,
                               taxonname_clean = clean_series_xgb$test$taxonname_clean)

# ---- HDBSCAN ----
# minPts = 5 is reasonable for series (some classes will be small)
hdb_series <- add_hdbscan_features(
  train_umap = train_umap_series,
  test_umap  = test_umap_series,
  outcome    = "taxonname_clean",
  minPts     = 5
)

# ---- XGBoost tuning ----
xgb_spec_series <- boost_tree(
  trees       = tune(),
  tree_depth  = tune(),
  learn_rate  = tune(),
  loss_reduction = tune(),
  min_n       = tune(),
  sample_size = tune(),
  mtry        = tune(),
  stop_iter   = 25
) %>%
  set_engine("xgboost") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

xgb_wf_series <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(xgb_spec_series) %>%
  add_formula(taxonname_clean ~ .)

min_class_n_xgb <- hdb_series$train %>%
  count(taxonname_clean) %>%
  summarise(mn = min(n)) %>%
  pull(mn)

v_xgb <- max(2, min(5, min_class_n_xgb))

# Use 3-fold CV to keep more samples per class per fold
set.seed(203)
folds_xgb_series <- vfold_cv(hdb_series$train, v = 3,
                              strata = taxonname_clean)

# Smaller grid to reduce chance of bad configurations
xgb_params_series <- parameters(
  trees(range          = c(200L, 1000L)),
  tree_depth(range     = c(2L, 6L)),
  learn_rate(range     = c(-2, -0.5)),
  loss_reduction(range = c(-2, 0)),
  min_n(range          = c(2L, 10L)),
  sample_prop(range    = c(0.6, 1.0)),
  finalize(mtry(), hdb_series$train %>% select(-taxonname_clean))
)

set.seed(204)
grid_xgb_series <- grid_latin_hypercube(xgb_params_series, size = 15)

cat("Tuning XGBoost + UMAP+HDBSCAN (series) ...\n")
tuned_xgb_series <- tune_grid(
  xgb_wf_series,
  resamples = folds_xgb_series,
  grid      = grid_xgb_series,
  metrics   = metric_set(bal_accuracy, kap, accuracy)
)

best_xgb_series <- select_best(tuned_xgb_series, metric = "kap")
cat("Best XGB params:\n"); print(best_xgb_series)

xgb_final_series <- finalize_workflow(xgb_wf_series, best_xgb_series) %>%
  fit(hdb_series$train)

pred_xgb_series <- predict(xgb_final_series, hdb_series$test, type = "prob") %>%
  bind_cols(predict(xgb_final_series, hdb_series$test, type = "class")) %>%
  bind_cols(hdb_series$test %>% select(taxonname_clean))

# ---- bundle ----
taxseries_xgb_bundle <- build_umap_hdb_bundle(
  name              = "taxseries_xgb_umap_hdb",
  outcome           = "taxonname_clean",
  train_raw         = clean_series_xgb$train,
  prep_rec          = prep_rec_series_xgb,
  final_fit         = xgb_final_series,
  umap_model_file   = "../outputs/models/taxseries_xgb_umap_hdb_umap.uwot",
  hdb_fit           = hdb_series$fit,
  z_train           = z_train_series,
  umap_n_components = UMAP_N_COMP,
  umap_n_neighbors  = UMAP_N_NEIGHBORS,
  umap_min_dist     = UMAP_MIN_DIST,
  umap_metric       = "euclidean",
  umap_seed         = UMAP_SEED
)

taxseries_xgb_bundle$metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, kap)(
  pred_xgb_series,
  truth    = taxonname_clean,
  estimate = .pred_class
)

taxseries_xgb_bundle$f_meas <- f_meas(
  pred_xgb_series,
  truth     = taxonname_clean,
  estimate  = .pred_class,
  estimator = "macro"
)

taxseries_xgb_bundle$conf_mat <- conf_mat(
  pred_xgb_series,
  truth    = taxonname_clean,
  estimate = .pred_class
)

saveRDS(taxseries_xgb_bundle,
        "../outputs/models/taxseries2_xgb_umap_hdb_bundle.rds")

cat("\n--- XGB + UMAP + HDBSCAN SERIES ---\n")
print(taxseries_xgb_bundle$metrics)
print(taxseries_xgb_bundle$f_meas)
beep("wilhelm")
```
```{r model3-xgb-plain}
# ============================================================
# MODEL 3: XGBoost PLAIN (no UMAP/HDBSCAN)
# ============================================================

set.seed(301)

clean_series_xgb_plain <- drop_bad_predictors(
  train_df  = train_series,
  test_df   = test_series,
  outcome   = "taxonname_clean",
  id_col    = "peiid",
  drop_cols = taxonomy_drop_cols_no_outcome
)

stopifnot("taxonname_clean" %in% names(clean_series_xgb_plain$train))

rec_series_xgb_plain <- recipe(taxonname_clean ~ ., data = clean_series_xgb_plain$train) %>%
  update_role(peiid, new_role = "id") %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

prep_rec_series_xgb_plain <- prep(rec_series_xgb_plain,
                                   training = clean_series_xgb_plain$train)

baked_train_xgb_plain <- bake(prep_rec_series_xgb_plain,
                               new_data = clean_series_xgb_plain$train) %>%
  select(-taxonname_clean, -peiid)

xgb_spec_plain <- boost_tree(
  trees          = tune(),
  tree_depth     = tune(),
  learn_rate     = tune(),
  loss_reduction = tune(),
  min_n          = tune(),
  sample_size    = tune(),

) %>%
  set_engine("xgboost") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

xgb_wf_plain <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(xgb_spec_plain) %>%
  add_recipe(rec_series_xgb_plain)

set.seed(302)
folds_xgb_plain <- vfold_cv(clean_series_xgb_plain$train, v = 3,
                              strata = taxonname_clean)

xgb_params_plain <- parameters(
  trees(range          = c(200L, 1000L)),
  tree_depth(range     = c(2L, 6L)),
  learn_rate(range     = c(-2, -0.5)),
  loss_reduction(range = c(-2, 0)),
  min_n(range          = c(2L, 10L)),
  sample_prop(range    = c(0.6, 1.0)),
  finalize(mtry(), baked_train_xgb_plain)
)

set.seed(303)
grid_xgb_plain <- grid_latin_hypercube(xgb_params_plain, size = 15)

cat("Tuning XGBoost plain (series) ...\n")
tuned_xgb_plain <- tune_grid(
  xgb_wf_plain,
  resamples = folds_xgb_plain,
  grid      = grid_xgb_plain,
  metrics   = metric_set(kap, accuracy)
)

best_xgb_plain <- select_best(tuned_xgb_plain, metric = "kap")
cat("Best XGB plain params:\n"); print(best_xgb_plain)

xgb_final_plain <- finalize_workflow(xgb_wf_plain, best_xgb_plain) %>%
  fit(clean_series_xgb_plain$train)

pred_xgb_plain <- predict(xgb_final_plain, clean_series_xgb_plain$test, type = "prob") %>%
  bind_cols(predict(xgb_final_plain, clean_series_xgb_plain$test, type = "class")) %>%
  bind_cols(clean_series_xgb_plain$test %>% select(taxonname_clean))

# ---- bundle ----
taxseries_xgb_plain_bundle <- build_plain_bundle(
  name      = "taxseries_xgb_plain",
  outcome   = "taxonname_clean",
  train_raw = clean_series_xgb_plain$train,
  prep_rec  = prep_rec_series_xgb_plain,
  final_fit = xgb_final_plain
)

taxseries_xgb_plain_bundle$metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, kap)(
  pred_xgb_plain,
  truth    = taxonname_clean,
  estimate = .pred_class
)

taxseries_xgb_plain_bundle$f_meas <- f_meas(
  pred_xgb_plain,
  truth     = taxonname_clean,
  estimate  = .pred_class,
  estimator = "macro"
)

taxseries_xgb_plain_bundle$conf_mat <- conf_mat(
  pred_xgb_plain,
  truth    = taxonname_clean,
  estimate = .pred_class
)

saveRDS(taxseries_xgb_plain_bundle,
        "../outputs/models/taxseries_xgb_plain_bundle.rds")

cat("\n--- XGB PLAIN SERIES ---\n")
print(taxseries_xgb_plain_bundle$metrics)
print(taxseries_xgb_plain_bundle$f_meas)

# ---- per-class accuracy ----
pred_xgb_plain %>%
  mutate(across(c(taxonname_clean, .pred_class), as.character)) %>%
  group_by(taxonname_clean) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_correct = sum(taxonname_clean == .pred_class),
    accuracy  = round(n_correct / n, 2),
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(accuracy)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  print()

beep("wilhelm")
```


```{r compare-models}
# ============================================================
# COMPARISON TABLE
# ============================================================

series_model_list <- list(
  taxseries_rf_plain       = taxseries_rf_bundle,
  taxseries_xgb_umap_hdb  = taxseries_xgb_bundle,
  taxseries_xgb_plain     = taxseries_xgb_plain_bundle
)

series_metric_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(series_model_list, function(x) {
  met_tbl <- x$metrics %>%
    select(.metric, .estimate) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = .metric, values_from = .estimate)

  f1_tbl <- x$f_meas %>% select(f_meas_macro = .estimate)

  bind_cols(
    tibble(model = x$name, outcome = x$outcome),
    met_tbl, f1_tbl
  )
})

cat("\n============================================\n")
cat("SERIES MODEL COMPARISON\n")
cat("============================================\n")
print(series_metric_summary)
```

```{r per-class-accuracy}
# ============================================================
# PER-CLASS ACCURACY (useful for many-class problems)
# ============================================================

per_class_acc <- function(pred_df, truth_col = "taxonname_clean",
                           pred_col = ".pred_class") {
  pred_df %>%
    rename(truth = all_of(truth_col), pred = all_of(pred_col)) %>%
    group_by(truth) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      n_correct = sum(as.character(truth) == as.character(pred)),
      acc = n_correct / n,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(acc))
}

cat("\n--- Per-class accuracy: RF plain ---\n")
print(per_class_acc(pred_rf_series), n = 50)

cat("\n--- Per-class accuracy: XGB + UMAP/HDBSCAN ---\n")
print(per_class_acc(pred_xgb_series), n = 50)

cat("\n--- Per-class accuracy: XGB plain ---\n")
print(per_class_acc(pred_xgb_plain), n = 50)
```

```{r what's wrong? }
# Where do misclassified pedons end up?
pred_rf_series %>%
  mutate(across(c(taxonname_clean, .pred_class), as.character)) %>%
  filter(taxonname_clean != .pred_class) %>%
  count(taxonname_clean, .pred_class, sort = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  print()

#orangeburg norfolk mix up is interesting

# Dothan → Orangeburg / Tifton — these three are the classic "Dothan-Orangeburg-Tifton" complex of the Southern Coastal Plain, separated primarily by plinthite depth and particle size control section. Morphologically nearly identical in many pedons

# Bonifay → Fuquay and Leefield → Fuquay — all three are Arenic or Grossarenic Paleudults with thick sandy mantles over Bt; the distinction is subtle subsurface criteria

# Blanton → Troup — both grossarenic, both sandy throughout, very similar morphology

# Eustis → Lakeland — both excessively drained sandy soils, Lakeland just lacks the Bt entirely

# Hornsville → Craven — both poorly drained, fine-textured, makes sense

# Albany → Blanton — both have thick sandy epipedons over loamy Bt

#Orangeburg → Norfolk — these are genuinely similar fine-loamy Hapludults/Kandiudults and this confusion shows up in real-world mapping too
```
